in_arabic.name: وسيقة
in_arabic.meaning: وثيقة تثبت الحق أو الحقيقة بشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الوسيقة في اللغة العربية تعني وثيقة أو دليل قاطع يثبت حقيقة أو حقًا ما. في سياق الأسماء الإسلامية، قد تشير إلى الثقة أو الإيمان القاطع بالله. يعتبر اسم وسيلة للدلالة على قوة الإيمان أو الالتزام بالحق.

in_urdu.name: وسیقہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک دستاویز یا ثبوت جو کسی حقیقت کو ثابت کرے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اردو میں، وسیقہ کا مطلب ہے ایک دستاویز یا ثبوت جو کسی حقیقت یا حق کو ثابت کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی ناموں کے تناظر میں، یہ نام ثقافت، اعتماد، یا قاطعہ ایمان کی علامت ہو سکتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں وثاقت اور یقین کے معانی سے وابستہ ہو سکتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: वसीक़त
in_hindi.meaning: एक दस्तावेज़ जो किसी तथ्य को प्रमाणित करे
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिंदी में, वसीक़त का अर्थ है एक दस्तावेज़ या प्रमाण जो किसी तथ्य या सच्चाई को स्थापित करता है। इस्लामी नामकरण परंपरा में, यह नाम विश्वास, सुरक्षा, या ईमानदारी की भावना को दर्शा सकता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में विश्वास और सत्यता के महत्व को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: وسیقه
in_pashto.meaning: دلیل یا ثبوت چې کوم حقیقت تصدیق کړي
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې، وسیقه دليل یا ثبوتي معنی لري چې کوم حقیقت یا حقیقت تصدیق کوي. د اسلامي نومونو په شرایطو کې، دا نوم د ثقافت، باور، یا پټنليک نښه کولی شي. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د مسلمانانو په مېنځ کې د مرجع او صداقت د ارزښتونو څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Wasiqat
in_english.meaning: A document or proof that confirms a fact or right
in_english.long_meaning: The name Wasiqat originates from Arabic roots, meaning a document, proof, or evidence that confirms a fact or right. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes trust, faith, and commitment to truth. The term has etymological roots in the Arabic word 'wathiqah,' which signifies a strong bond or conviction. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to signify reliability and sincerity. It reflects the importance of documentation and evidence in establishing justice and truth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Wasiqat" holds a significant impact in Islamic culture. It is often used to describe an individual who is committed, resolute, and focused on achieving their goals. This embodies the values of perseverance and determination that are highly regarded in Islamic society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Wasiqat" can be seen as a reflection of Allah's attribute of "Wasi" or "Guardian." Just as Allah is the One who guards and protects His creation, a person named Wasiqat is encouraged to embody this quality by taking decisive action to protect and care for those around them. This name serves as a daily reminder to act with intention, purpose, and commitment, not only to oneself but also to others.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 11, Page 53-54. The name Wasiqat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The Battle of the Camel (656 AD) between Ali ibn Abi Talib and Aisha. One of Ali's commanders was a man named Wasiqat ibn Shikab. Aisha appointed Marwan ibn Al-Hakam as her commander, and Marwan was killed by Wasiqat.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hakam's Futuh Misr, Page 157. The name Wasiqat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: During the conquest of Egypt, the Muslim forces were divided into different groups, one of which was led by Wasiqat ibn Shikab.
